skew and diagonal paused their own entries at 16:59Z (research); their forward twins, which never pause, sent nothing after 16:59Z either.

The forward tick is one a snapshot (60 s) where the live floor's ran 60-200 s: fills land within minutes of the live ones, earlier or later (orb's open 5.5 minutes earlier, its close 1.6 minutes later; skew's 0.5 and 4.5 minutes later).
findings: 1. The book's 10% limit band refused every structure exit and slipped entry priced through the touch until V4 (18:33Z): over the whole session under the House before V4, orb's exits were refused 37 times (its signal exit at half the mark, its clock exit at 0.01) and it holds its IWM vertical into the weekend; condor-vrp's slipped condor entry was refused. Under the House on main (V4's re-pricing all day) the same session closes 2 structures: condor-vrp -43.40 (a 0-DTE SPY condor opened 15:45Z, stopped at 16:13Z) and orb +10.80: desk -32.60 on 2 closed, 2 skew verticals open at -21.20.

2. The live chain has NO greeks on a contract expiring today (12,882 of 12,882 0-DTE index rows and 7,986 of 7,986 0-DTE stock rows in the House's 248 recorded chains): the six S4b founders (orb, gap-drift, reversal, skew, trend-vertical, diagonal) pick strikes by the chain's delta, so they can never trade a 0-DTE structure live. The six S4a founders compute their own. What-if (not the House): with Black-Scholes greeks on today's expiries, orb trades a 0-DTE IWM 281/282 call vertical 15:26-16:01Z for +27.80 instead of the 3-day one. The deltas the forward test computes match Alpaca's within 0.003 where Alpaca gives them, so the House could compute them the same way.

3. Target (3 agents, 2+ closed structures each, positive): 0 in every run and live. Live options desk on structures: 1 closed (orb +5.80), 3 open (skew's two verticals, krasker-22's CCL condor). No structure evidence today bears on O4.

4. Calibration: S3's table must NOT be adopted for the ETFs. Refit on 82,861 of the day's pairs (17,843 on 0-DTE legs), the ETF buckets move from 0.02/0.07/0.25/2.79 to 0.07/0.31/1.11/1.98; S3's own ETF buckets, held out on the day, are tighter than the real touch 17.0% (buy) and 18.5% (sell) of the time against its 2.5% design (the current estimate 12.9%/13.6%). The stock buckets hold (S3's table 1.8%/1.2% held out; refit 0.07/0.14/0.29/0.45/0.83 against 0.06/0.14/0.46/1.02/1.86). The ETF need is price drift since the print, not spread: the quoted half-spread is $0.005 while the 97.5th percentile need on $0.5-3 legs grows 0.15 -> 0.27 -> 0.44 as the print ages 0-60 -> 60-180 -> 180-300 s (0-DTE 0.57). Fitted within a minute of the bar's close only: 0.04/0.15/0.98/1.93 (ETF). A print-priced replay cannot judge penny-wide ETF structures honestly; a replay on recorded quotes (this harness) can. Control: the same code on S3's days returns S3's table exactly (11,111 pairs, every bucket equal).
caveats: Practice evidence on a simulated book, never a real result; the forward test is the founders' code, not the live agents' after rewrites.
